verdict.rationale: Pre-built project templates are a fair question for a project-management tool like ClickUp, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions templates. The Asana and Jira import features cover data migration, which is a different capability from starting a project from a pre-built template, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can jumpstart a new project using pre-built templates
